prior_importants.description: When `--numstat` reports a binary rename or mode-only change as `-\t-`, the old and new oids are the same. Two kinds of file now get flagged where they used to be skipped: a file outside the table (GIF, PDF, WOFF2, WebP), and a PNG over 1 MiB. The recount diffs the oid against itself, which gives `{0, 0}`, and `countChangedLines` still pushes it to `forged` because it only checks `!recount`. Known PNGs moved unchanged also spend the 4 MiB budget.

findings.description: The PR drops `--literal-pathspecs` and switches to inline pathspec magic, `` `:(top,literal)${path}` ``. The env var `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1` turns off magic parsing completely, and `scrubbedGitEnv` does not remove it. So when pup's own environment carries it, `git diff -U0 target...branch -- ':(top,literal)src/a.ts'` looks for a file literally named `:(top,literal)src/a.ts`. That matches nothing, and `gitDiffAddedLines` returns `{}`. The same root cause reaches the new `':(top)'` pathspec in `filesNaming`, whose grep then lists no importers.
findings.body:
**Inline pathspec magic is read as a literal name when `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1` is inherited**

This change replaces `--literal-pathspecs` with inline pathspec magic:

```ts
for (const hunk of diffHunks(repoPath, [
  `${target}...${branch}`,
  '--',
  `:(top,literal)${path}`,
])) {
```
https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/030d85dcf9bc07c678e354f3b9953965d5f26fcf/src/core/git-diff.client.ts#L886-L892

When `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1` is in the environment, git does not parse pathspec magic at all (`parse_element_magic` returns early when `get_literal_global()` is set; this is pinned-version knowledge of `pathspec.c`, not a spike). `scrubbedGitEnv` uses a denylist, and that denylist does not include the pathspec-mode variables, so the variable reaches every child git:
https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/030d85dcf9bc07c678e354f3b9953965d5f26fcf/src/core/git-diff.client.ts#L40-L47

Git exports this variable to its children when it runs as `git --literal-pathspecs …`. That covers a hook or alias that runs pup, which is the "pup itself runs inside a git hook" case `scrubbedGitEnv`'s JSDoc already guards against. An operator can also export it. When it is set:
- `gitDiffAddedLines` looks for a file literally named `:(top,literal)<path>`, finds no hunks, and returns `{}`. `patchCoverage` then sees `instrumented: 0`, so patch coverage passes with nothing measured.
- `filesNaming`'s new `-- ':(top)'` greps for a literal file named `:(top)` and exits 1, so no importers are listed. `reachableTestFiles` then never moves an imported test file into source, and the diff-size split counts that source as tests (https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/030d85dcf9bc07c678e354f3b9953965d5f26fcf/src/core/merge-gate.service.ts#L572). Before this PR the grep had no pathspec and searched the whole tree.
- The pre-existing `:(top,glob,icase)**/<name>` in `dependenciesNameDocusaurus` already failed the same way.

Before this PR, `diffHunks` passed `--literal-pathspecs`, which sets the same mode itself, so the inherited value did not matter. A session cannot set the variable for the operator's pup process, so this is not a gate evasion. It is a fail-open the PR introduced under an environment the code already says it expects.

**Fix:** drop the pathspec-mode variables in `scrubbedGitEnv`. That fixes all three call sites, and `pinnedGitEnv` too. `GIT_ICASE_PATHSPECS` belongs on the list as well: under `:(literal)` it would let `src/a.ts` also match `src/A.ts` and merge the two files' hunks. A test that runs `gitDiffAddedLines` with `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1` in `process.env` would pin the fix.

findings.description: The line `export { BINARY_FREE_MAX_BYTES, BINARY_FREE_TOTAL_MAX_BYTES } from './known-binary.utils.js'` exists only so merge-gate.service.ts can import the two caps from git-diff.client.js. The alternative is for merge-gate.service.ts to import them directly from './known-binary.utils.js' and drop this re-export, which removes one export statement and its comment. The cost to the next maintainer is two places that appear to own the caps, and git-diff.client.ts keeps a dependency on known-binary.utils.ts that only serves a pass-through.

The ADR says a source file renamed into a `.png` is recounted "with both paths in the recount's pathspec". `gitDiffBinaryRecount` no longer takes paths for the recount: it reads `diffHunks(repoPath, [baseBlob.oid, branchBlob.oid])` or `blobLines` by oid. The ADR itself says so at lines 111-113 ("The recount reads the same oids"), so the two sections contradict each other. The same stale wording is at lines 148-149, where "The per-file diff behind the recount and patch coverage takes `:(top,literal)<path>`" should name patch coverage only. Drop the pathspec clause and say the recount diffs both oids.

After validation, the review-correctness finding at src/core/git-blobs.client.ts:19-37 was downgraded to nit: readBlobs' exact maxBuffer overflows on any git stderr output, such as GIT_TRACE. It was then dropped as a repeat, because round 1 had already posted it as a minor at its old location, git-diff.client.ts:566-587. The simplicity nit about DiffSides' three-variant union was dropped because the author declared that typing intentional in commit 4c2ab2a.
